sources.title: Current Lab Members
sources.text: Current Lab Members Meet Our Team Zvinka Zlatar, Ph.D. Principal Investigator Dr. Zlatar received her PhD in clinical psychology from the University of Florida with a focus on adult neuropsychology/geropsychology. She completed her APA-accredited clinical psychology internship at the University of California, Los Angeles (Semel Institute for Neuroscience and Human Behavior), focusing on the neuropsychological assessment of older adults and Spanish-speaking adults. She then completed a postdoctoral fellowship in neurocognitive aging at the University of California, San Diego with an emphasis on imaging the neural substrates of physical activity in older adults. In 2016, she joined the faculty of the Department of Psychiatry at UC San Diego. Her research focuses on developing and deploying innovative, person-centered digital health interventions designed to reduce dementia risk in older adults. By moving beyond traditional laboratory-based protocols, Dr. Zlatar implements real-world, free-living approaches that target modifiable lifestyle factors, such as increasing physical activity and reducing sedentary time, to promote brain and cognitive health in aging. She also studies early detection of dementia and the clinical utility of subjective cognitive decline in Hispanic/Latino(a) older adults. Andrea-Paula Vargas Reseach Assistant I place great value on understanding what I can do to help create stronger and healthier communities. In the future, I hope to continue in a health-related profession where I can continue learning more about healthy aging while helping promote diversity and inclusivity within STEM. A few of my favorite activities include swimming, hiking, painting pottery, and watching baking shows. I also love traveling to new places and trying new things with friends and family. Rosa Gutierrez Aceves Research Coordinator Rosa has served as a research coordinator for large clinical trials focused on adult mental illness and/or aging for over 13 years. As a bilingual and bicultural community health worker, she has extensive expertise in community outreach throughout San Diego County.

sources.title: Former Lab Members
sources.text: Former Lab Members Meet Our Lab Alumni Destiny Martinez Ruiz Undergraduate Research Assistant I am a second-year undergraduate at UCSD, learning about research and studying Cognitive Behavioral Neuroscience. My passion is to explore ways to best support people in having healthier lives. I’m excited to have the chance to serve Latinx/Hispanic communities and to promote their representation in healthcare, hoping to one day work in the field of medicine. Outside of work and school, cooking is my happy place. I always love to share a fresh meal with my friends and roommates at the dorm. At the same time, it brings me joy to share photos of new foods with my family back at home. Marina Zaher Nakhla Graduate Student Marina Zaher Nakhla graduated from CSU Northridge with a Bachelor's degree in Psychology and Master's degree in Clinical Psychology. She is currently a fourth-year Ph.D. candidate at the San Diego State University/University of California San Diego Joint Doctoral Program in Clinical Psychology with an emphasis in neuropsychology. Marina is a Strategic Enhancement of Excellence through Diversity (SEED) fellow and a graduate researcher in both Dr. Zvinka Zlatar's WISE Laboratory and Dr. Dawn Schiehser's Neurocognition and Movement Laboratory. Her research interests involve cognitive aging, as well as the intersection between neuropsychological disorders, physical disability, and mental health. She also has interests in working with underrepresented populations in both research and clinical practice. Gisselle Santiago Undergraduate Research Assistant Gisselle is a fourth-year undergraduate student at UC San Diego majoring in Human Biology and Global Health. She is currently on the pre-med track and hopes to attend medical school after taking a gap year to work in the field. She is interested in learning more about how neurodegenerative diseases affect minority populations, specifically for Hispanics/Latinos. Emily Pantoja Undergraduate Research Assistant Lynn Cohen Undergraduate Research Assistant/Lab Manager Lynn majored in Cognitive and Behavioral Neuroscience. Her research interests include dementia, traumatic brain injury, and brain imaging. She plans on pursuing a graduate degree in Neuropsychology. Caitlin Knight Lab Manager | Undergraduate Research Assistant Caitlin majored in Psychology, with a specialization in Cognitive Psychology. She is interested in learning and memory research, and hopes one day to work in Cognitive Behavioral Therapy. Allison Williams Undergraduate Research Assistant Allison majored in Biochemistry & Cell Biology major and minored in Psychology. She is a pre-med student who hopes to go into the field of Psychiatry or Neurology. Her research interests involve preventative psychiatry and neurodegenerative diseases. Maya Eshel Undergraduate Research Assistant Maya majored in Communications with a Psychology minor. She is interested in cognitive aging and language research. Following the completion of her undergraduate studies at UC San Diego she hopes to pursue a degree in Clinical Psychology. JD Lewis Undergraduate Research Assistant JD Lewis graduated from UC San Diego. His psychological interests include motivation, mindfulness, emotions, understanding, and performance psychology. He is currently looking into graduate programs to continue his education in the field of psychology. Colin Carey Graduate Research Assistant Colin Carey is a Ph.D. student in clinical psychology at the California School of Professional Psychology at Alliant International University, San Diego. He served as an elective practice graduate student research assistant at the WISE lab under the supervision of Dr. Zvinka Zlatar from June 2017 - June 2018. In this role, he administered the lab's neuropsychological assessment battery to older adults at three study timepoints, scored and interpreted assessments, and compiled summary feedback letters for participants. Additionally, he conducted thorough physical health, exercise, and psychosocial phone screenings with potential participants and assisted in participant recruitment efforts. During his time at the WISE lab, Colin also administered neuropsychological assessment batteries at the Veterans Medical Research Foundation (VMRF) to participants in a longitudinal study of individuals at-risk for developing Alzheimer's Disease. Jessica Osuna Undergraduate Research Assistant/Research Coordinator Jessica Osuna worked at the WISE Lab as the research coordinator from March 2016 to June 2018. She continues to be involved in aging-related studies at UCSD and the VA San Diego. Her primary research interests are focused on how vascular risks contribute to cognitive trajectories in healthy and pathological aging, and how such vascular contributions may inform intervention strategies. Aside from research, Jessica enjoys spending time with her pets, competing in marathons, and playing soccer with her team. Lauren Johnson Undergraduate Research Assistant Lauren Toomey worked under Dr. Zlatar in the WISE Lab from May 2017 to May 2018. She was a research assistant and helped with participant recruitment, cognitive testing, and data entry/analysis. During that time, she was a senior at UCSD and co-currently working under Dr. Wierenga in her research lab at the VA Hospital. She has now received her degree in Cognitive Science with Specialization in Neuroscience and has plans to work with neuropsychiatric research and pursue her PhD. Mikaela Orner Undergraduate Research Assistant Mikaela worked as a Research Assistant in the WISE Lab from December 2016 to December 2017. During her time in the lab, she helped create study materials, worked one-on-one with participants, and administered neuropsychological assessments. In March of 2018, she graduated from UC San Diego with a B.S. in Cognitive and Behavioral Neuroscience and a minor in Biology. After graduating, she went on to become a Project Coordinator for the Brain Development Imaging Labs, an autism research lab, at San Diego State University.
